text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am "The Empress," Air Groove. I bear this title to stand as an ideal and guiding compass for all Umamusume.
Air Groove ceaselessly strove to become her ideal "Empress."
I may not comprehend every facet yet, but seeing the world through her lens brought me to a singular conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Understood…! Thank you so much, Air Groove-san! I'll try it right away…!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you, Air Groove-san!
The bright smiles of her juniors—and above all, the gentle warmth in Air Groove's eyes as she watched over them.
Guiding her juniors and executing Student Council duties were indispensable pillars of who she was.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: —Eh? You will oversee my tailored training menu instead of Air Groove-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Wow, thank you so much! First, regarding muscle conditioning for explosive acceleration…

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text: Ugh, compiling these reports is impossible… Maybe I should ask the Vice President for help…
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, I can help instead.
If you don't mind, I can help instead.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text: Huh? You'll take care of it? Please do! About sorting these ballot counts—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You. What do you think you are doing?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do not play dumb. Did you assume I would not notice? You took over my junior coaching and Student Council paperwork behind my back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What prompted this absurd overreach? Are you attempting to clear away what you deem 'worthless distractions'?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Answer me. Depending on your response, our contract ends here and now!
choice_data_list: Because the things you cherish, I want to cherish as well
Because the things you cherish, I want to cherish as well

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …What?
choice_data_list: Let me help you, as your trainer.
Let me help you, as your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Help…?
I told Air Groove to keep fulfilling every duty she treasured—and simply rely on me to shoulder the logistical weight to secure her training hours.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. "Rely on me"? Bold words for someone who has yet to prove their competence.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However… 
Hm…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Contract stands. That is all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …A partner capable of matching stride along the path of supreme ambition.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer… is it.
With backend support gradually falling into place, Air Groove tackled her training with unprecedented intensity.
Then came the Maiden race—where Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Top pick Air Groove seizes the front instantly out of the gate! Will she wash away the sting of her debut?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph…!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: She pulls further ahead! Air Groove shows blinding speed! Widening a chasm that displays overwhelming class difference!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Gooooooaaal! An absolute, crushing victory! Dominant! A massive five-length margin!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The peerless "Empress," Air Groove! 
Her legend begins now!

The day after that spectacular victory, I received a message from Air Groove: 
"There is something I need your help with."
Better hurry to her...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You took your time. 
...Hm? Why are you gasping for breath like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that. We begin immediately. 
The seeds I ordered arrived today.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Flowers.

And so, I began planting flower seeds with Air Groove 
in the bed behind the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How many times must I repeat myself! 
Do not heap that much soil over newly sown seeds!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You lack precision in every step you take. Listen well: 
handling seeds requires far greater delicacy—
Despite continuous scolding, I managed to see the work through to completion...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good. That should suffice. 
...I await their sprouting and eventual bloom.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What, find that unexpected? 
...Your surprise is written all over your face.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Cultivate them with proper discipline and care, and shoots will rise without fail, eventually blooming in full splendor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Blossoms leave behind new seed, 
and from those seeds, new aspirations take root once more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—The catalyst that sparked my own growth 
was watching my mother run across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are surely aware that whoever claims the G1 Yushun Himba 
earns the title "Queen of the Oaks."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My mother seized that crown 
amidst ruthless competition.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her stride... it sent shivers down my spine. 
I revered that absolute strength and resolved to reach those heights.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I dreamed of honing myself to the absolute limit and seizing ultimate triumph. 
That was when my passion for racing bloomed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Above all... I resolved to become an inspiration to others, 
just as my mother was to me as a child.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is why I chose the mantle of "Empress." 
To stand as the ideal, the standard every Umamusume strives toward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as my mother showed me back then... 
I will prove that a glorious future lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Therefore, merely winning races is inadequate. 
Upholding this academy's dignity and guiding my juniors are equally my duty.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If a Trainer dismissed all that as useless baggage and cast it aside, 
I had no need for one...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However... well. If it is you... 
I suppose placing a fraction of my trust in you is acceptable...
choice_data_list: Please rely on me more and more from now on!
Please rely on me more and more from now on!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
S-Silence! Prove your worth through results 
before uttering such presumptuous nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good grief. The road ahead will clearly test my patience...!
choice_data_list: I'm just glad there is a future!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do not steal my line, fool!
And so, my days alongside the "Empress" Air Groove began!
